desc: Boeing enters this record through two doors. The first is testimonial: at the 26 July 2023 House Oversight hearing Ryan Graves described the October 2003 Vandenberg incident in which a large group of Boeing contractors working near a launch facility observed a red square roughly a hundred yards across hovering silently over missile defense sites - an account repeated in sworn testimony on 9 September 2025 by Jeffrey Nuccetelli, who investigated the events. Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez seized on the detail in 2023 to ask both witnesses about interactions between defense contractor companies and UAP programs, and Grusch answered that contractors have no obligation to report such encounters. The second door is corporate lineage: Boeing absorbed McDonnell Douglas in 1997, inheriting the Huntington Beach astronautics organisation where Robert Wood ran a company-funded study of unidentified craft in the late 1960s, along with whatever record that study generated. Boeing's Phantom Works is the direct analogue of Skunk Works. USAspending records prime contract obligations to Boeing entities exceeding $100 billion since FY2008.
